The hidden cost of manual fixture cleaning

Hand-scrubbing fixtures is quietly taxing your line

Every scratched fixture, every slow clean and every residue-contaminated board costs money. A batch cleaning machine changes that math.

Fixtures too dirty to clean by hand

Flux, grease and dust bake onto fixtures; manual scrubbing takes forever and still misses the inside.

Iron-brush damage

Manual cleaning with brushes scratches fixture surfaces and shortens tooling life.

One-by-one inefficiency

Cleaning fixtures individually is slow, low-efficiency work that ties up operators.

High labor cost

Dedicated cleaning staff and constant re-cleaning drain the budget.

Residue contaminates boards

Dirty fixtures transfer flux residue to the next board — defects you can trace to tooling.

Harsh chemicals

Aggressive manual cleaning agents are hard on the environment and the fixtures.

Installation guide

Install and commission the SME-5200

Reference procedure based on the SME-5200 operation and maintenance manual. Full documentation ships with the machine.

01 · Site preparation

Place the machine on a level floor with water supply, drainage and power at the position. Keep clearance around the machine for basket loading.

02 · Utilities

Connect water supply and drainage, and the electrical supply per the nameplate. Fill the detergent tank with the recommended cleaning liquid.

03 · Pre-run check

Verify pumps, nozzles and filters are seated; confirm the 20 µm filters are clean and the basket rotates freely.

04 · Test cycle

Run a test cycle with a sample fixture: spray clean, drain, recycle and hot-air dry, then inspect the result.

05 · Training & routine

Train operators on basket loading, cycle selection and daily maintenance; schedule filter cleaning and detergent checks.

Technical evaluation FAQ

Questions buyers ask before ordering

What can the SME-5200 clean?

Grease, flux and dust from all kinds of SMT fixtures, trays, reflow oven coolers and filters, and wave-soldering parts — in composite stone, steel and aluminum.

How does the cleaning process work?

Put fixtures into the round basket and press start. Rinse pumps drive 720° rotary spray over all surfaces, the liquid is cleaned by 20 µm filters and recycled, then hot air dries the batch.

Will cleaning damage my fixtures?

No — automated spray cleaning replaces iron-brush scrubbing, so fixtures are not scratched or worn. Cleaning actually extends tooling life.

Is the machine environmentally friendly?

Yes — the cleaning liquid is filtered and recycled, reducing detergent and water use compared with manual methods.

Which models are available?

The SME-5200 batch fixture cleaner, the SME-5300 fixture cleaner, rotary-spray machines with optional ultrasonic assist, and nozzle cleaning machines (S-6200 / SME24) for placement nozzles.

How do I get a price and delivery time?

Email info@smthelp.com or WhatsApp +86 136 0256 2576 with your fixture types, volumes and facility details. Quotation and delivery schedule are provided after technical confirmation — typically the same working day.
